description: First release of YouTube Extras, for YouTube 21.44.528 with Morphe Patches v2.1.0-dev.12. Add the source https://github.com/bryceaspringfield/morphe/youtube in Morphe and select it together with Morphe Patches. Settings: Settings > Morphe > YouTube Extras. See youtube/README.md.

patches.name: YouTube Extras
patches.description: Adds channel filters, video length, category, and topic filters, playlists on Home, live chat on all messages, and the other options of Settings > Morphe > YouTube Extras.
